# evroc_think_instance (Data Source)

Get information about an existing evroc Think instance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Think instance to look up.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the instance is located.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the instance was created (RFC3339 format).
- `endpoint` (String) OpenAI-compatible API endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `instance_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the instance.
- `model` (String) Model being served by this instance.
- `phase` (String) Current lifecycle phase (Creating, Running, Stopped, Failed, etc.).
- `size` (String) Instance size for GPU allocation.
